The only UK‑born Nobel laureate in the Economic Sciences who was affiliated with a UK institution at the time of the award, between the award’s inception in 1969 and the year the first woman won (2023), is John Hicks (1972).  
His ideas.repec.org profile lists over 35 “Articles” published prior to 1972, far exceeding the 20‑article threshold.  
No other UK‑born laureate with a UK affiliation meets the condition.
